frozenBefore: any Step 1C HTTP request, any reading of a Step 1C evaluation page, and any gold annotation
question: Can a general, deterministic attribution procedure use grammatical and structural evidence to reduce wrong-product assignments without unnecessarily losing correct findings?
authorisation: owner Step 1C brief (2026-10-17): at most 18 HTTP requests, at most 5 hosts, at most 6 requests per host, within 7 days; robots checks and redirects count; limited to obtaining independent original comparative-review evidence for this experiment; does not extend, renew or reuse the Phase272 budget

arms.name: current tuned attribution (body and table-header mentions + nearest-name clause rule)
constrained attribution candidate (src/experience_attribution_candidate.ts) over the current readers
ablation: ambiguity-only withholding (Step 1B counterfactual: several products named before the value -> unresolved)

knowledgeState.governingState: the compiled plan digest per category, which must equal evaluation/phase272/plans-frozen-known.json (the run refuses otherwise)

codeFreeze: evaluation/step1c/freeze.sha256 (candidate, scorer, evaluation and observer scripts, compiled modules, this protocol, and the reader files of the frozen and current builds); the run refuses if any listed file changed
sameInputs: every arm reads the same page bytes (SHA-256 checked against the wave receipt), the same live-store plan (digest must equal evaluation/phase272/plans-frozen-known.json), once
candidatePrecedence: R1 explicit local structure: comparison-table column; value in parentheses directly after a product (also a product named once with a model code, or a 'Product: value' label); value owned by an unnamed referent (its predecessor/rival ...) -> unresolved; possessive '<product>'s ... value'; '<product> and its ... value'

R1e multi-subject: 'both' with exactly two named products in the sentence -> multi-subject; 'both' in comparison wording without two named products -> unresolved with candidates; 'both' about non-products is ignored

R2 grammatical subject: the only product in the clause not in an object position (than, against, by, like, prepositions, coordination with an object), near the clause head; fronted values; an elided subject inherits the previous clause's subject

R3 no competing local evidence: a pronoun subject takes the previous sentence's subject in the same block; a non-comparative section heading naming one product; else the document main product only when the section heading names no product in a non-object position; a headline-like page name is not an identity
R4 otherwise unresolved, recording candidate subjects, the reason and the evidence that would resolve it

sourceSelection.method: web-search result titles and URLs only, before any page body is read; each page's search-summary exposure is recorded; a page whose search summary shows any of its measured values is excluded
sourceSelection.eligible: a publicly accessible (no login, paywall, CAPTCHA) first-hand review or head-to-head comparison by an independent publisher that reports its own measured results for at least two named products of one taught category with a frozen plan digest (televisions, air purifiers, air fryers, dishwashers: evaluation/phase272/plans-frozen-known.json); robots.txt allows ProductEvidenceResearchBot or *; no ai-input=no, noai or TDM reservation
sourceSelection.excluded: any URL fetched in any earlier phase (all earlier wave receipts), any page examined for development or tuning, manufacturer and retailer pages, aggregators without their own tests
sourceSelection.target: 4 to 6 pages, at least two categories and at least two publishers; stop when 6 eligible pages are fetched or the budget cannot reach another
sourceSelection.shortfall: fewer than 4 eligible pages: report the shortfall; previously used pages are never substituted as untouched

transport: scripts/phase246-live-wave.mjs, one state file in the private evaluation directory (robots-checked restricted HTTPS transport, agent ProductEvidenceResearchBot, politeness >= 5 s per host); robots.txt and each redirect hop count; stop on robots disallow, 401/403/429, Retry-After, 3 errors on a host, cross-site or self redirect, paywall or login wall
retention: page bytes only in the private evaluation directory outside Git (never in either repository); the plain-text annotator renderings likewise; the private repository keeps gold, runs and the request log, no page bytes

goldRules.annotator: a separate Claude agent with a fresh context, given only the plain-text renderings and these rules; it sees no extractor code, no extractor output, no experience case and no candidate rule; this is separation, not author independence
goldRules.values: every number the publisher reports as its OWN measured test result for a named product (prose, list, table cell, caption), with its unit as printed; includes results reported for compared rival products; excludes manufacturer specifications and claims, prices, ratings or scores, settings, loads, ranges, bounds, hypothetical figures and other publishers' numbers
goldRules.subjectStatus: exact (the page establishes one product); shared (the page states the same result for several named products: one item per product with a common group); undetermined (the page reports the value but does not establish whose it is; subject null)
goldRules.variants: acceptedVariants only where the page itself establishes that two names denote the same product (evidence recorded)
goldRules.conditions: the conditions the page states for the value (mode, window, setting, distance, programme), as short labels
goldRules.freeze: gold hash and counts are committed (evaluation/step1c/gold-freeze.json) before any arm runs; gold contents stay private

scoring: src/experience_attribution_scoring.ts (frozen): per gold item correct | correct_multi | false_identity_match | unresolved | wrong_product | missing; for undetermined items correctly_unresolved | unsupported_assignment | missing; per lead lead_correct | lead_multi_correct | lead_multi_overreach | lead_wrong_product | lead_false_identity | lead_unsupported | lead_unresolved | lead_not_gold_value; identity = the Phase272 shared-token rule plus brand consistency; unresolved is never counted as correct; units canonicalised identically for gold and leads

states.failure: wrong_product, false_identity_match, unsupported_assignment (confidently wrong); missing (not read)
states.unresolved: unresolved: retained without a subject (safe, not correct)

decisionRule.promising: all of: (1) C has fewer confidently wrong items than both A and B; (2) C introduces no confidently wrong item that B did not have (newConfidentlyWrong B->C = 0); (3) C has at least as many successes as D (better than ambiguity-only withholding); (4) C keeps at least as many successes as B minus one
decisionRule.inconclusive: fewer than 20 attributable gold items, or the C-vs-B difference in confidently wrong items is at most 1, or the criteria conflict
decisionRule.notPromising: otherwise; a failed or inconclusive result is reported as such
decisionRule.noPostHocChange: no rule, gold or scoring change after the first run counts as untouched; any later correction is a separately labelled development run

reporting: per-document and per-arm counts with denominators; lead-level counts beside item-level counts; transitions between arms; the rules used by C; tiers kept apart (T1 synthetic, development pages, untouched first run, never production)
